name: Tharados
description: Tharados was a small, cold planet that was located within the Tharados system of the Mid Rim. The Zabrak Haast Aath ran a slave compound there for Riboga the Hutt. Twelve clone troopers were also sent there during the Clone Wars, due to an administrative error.
